body:
GBM test7: monochrome sign-in, globe and payment UI; startup progress and safe retry; bounded engine handshake; compatible Android renderer.

Android 5.5.9 (50509), release build signed with the existing Android Debug certificate for in-place upgrades. Asset filenames retain -debug.apk for updater compatibility. Windows is being packaged separately. Real funded payment and VPN end-to-end were not verified by this release acceptance.
